svg.title: Which check found which bug in the agent-written send panel
svg.desc: Bombadil, clicking the real page for 150 seconds, found the double-send bug and the cancel bug and missed the two bugs that need an upload to finish. TLC, checking a TLA+ model, found all four in under three seconds. After the fix, Bombadil reported 0 violations in 150 seconds and TLC found all four rules hold.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two kinds of proof, two kinds of blind spot
